definition.install_delta_unique_bytes: new unique file-content bytes introduced by the reinstall projection; hardlinks to an already-owned canonical launcher count as zero unique content bytes
definition.logical_path_bytes: apparent file/symlink payload size at the install path; not equivalent to unique disk content
definition.canonical_runtime_code_bytes: CATFOOD-owned shared implementation bytes in shoal_workcell.py + shoal_runtime.py + finite_ram_control.py
definition.claim_boundary: zero install delta is NOT zero total software footprint; shared base model, adapter/checkpoint, Python/torch and OS remain external/shared substrate

interpretation: Reinstall projections converged to zero additional unique content bytes while the shared canonical substrate gained capabilities. The canonical implementation itself did not shrink to zero; instead implementation sharing and capability density improved.
